name: wordpress-mcp
description: WordPress (builder tools): me, list_items, get_item, create_item, update_item, delete_item. Every to

platform_mcp_wordpress_application_passw.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WORDPRESS_APPLICATION_PASSWORD
platform_mcp_wordpress_application_passw.description: Application Password for that user (Users > Profile > Application Passwords, WordPress 5.6+), sent with HTTP Basic auth over HTTPS.

platform_mcp_wordpress_site.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WORDPRESS_SITE
platform_mcp_wordpress_site.description: The site's host (and path if WordPress lives in a subdirectory), e.g. example.com or example.com/blog; pretty permalinks must be enabled so /wp-json/ resolves.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /wp/v2/users/me?context=edit: the authenticated user with roles and capabilities.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: GET /wp/v2/{posts|pages|<custom post type rest_base>}?page&per_page (≤100)&search&status=any&context=edit: collection defaults to posts; includes drafts and private items the user can edit.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: GET /wp/v2/{collection}/{id}?context=edit: raw title and content (block markup).

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: POST /wp/v2/{collection} {title, content, status, excerpt, slug, categories, tags, featured_media}: creates a post/page (status defaults to draft; pass fields.status = publish to publish).

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: POST /wp/v2/{collection}/{id}: updates only the given properties.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: DELETE /wp/v2/{collection}/{id}: moves the item to the trash (status trash); force=true is not sent, so it can be restored.
